description: The NFZ Statistics portal publishes what Poland's public health insurer pays for: hospital and specialist services, reimbursed medicines in pharmacies, drug programmes and chemotherapy. It is run by the Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia (NFZ), the National Health Fund that finances publicly funded care in Poland. Hospital activity is shown for the JGP catalogue, the Polish diagnosis-related groups, and for separate, radiotherapy and highly specialised services, in general, settlement, medical and cross-sectional views. Pharmacy statistics give numbers of packages and values of reimbursed medicines by product, ATC group and the area where the pharmacy is located. Drug programme and chemotherapy statistics give patients and reimbursement by active substance, sex and age group. The data are free on the portal and available to download through four public APIs. Caveats: figures are statistical values and not financial reports, the API host blocked automated requests from this environment so responses were not checked, and the spatial detail depends on each view. Simulation uses: setting hospital demand by diagnosis group and region for capacity models, and tracking medicine distribution through pharmacies by area. Related records: the Romanian DRG hospital indicators (data-inmss-romania-drg-hospital-indicators) and the French DREES hospital statistics (data-drees-sae-hospital-annual-statistics) are comparable sources.
